description_en: Retrieves the list of IA storage class files and subdirectories that contain IA storage class files under a specified directory in a General-purpose NAS file system
description_zh: 获取通用型NAS指定目录下的低频存储文件和包含低频存储文件的子目录列表
name: ListDirectoriesAndFiles

parameters.help_en:
The absolute path of the specified directory.

The path must start with a forward slash (/) and must be an existing path in the mount target
parameters.help_zh:
指定目录的绝对路径。

必须以正斜线（/）开头，并且是挂载点中真实存在的路径
parameters.name: path

parameters.help_en: The pagination token that is used in the next request to retrieve a new page of results. If the return results are truncated, you can use NextToken to initiate a new request to retrieve the content after the current truncation position
parameters.help_zh: 当请求的返回结果被截断时，您可以使用NextToken再次发起请求，获取从当前截断位置之后的内容
parameters.name: next_token

parameters.help_en:
The storage class type.
InfrequentAccess: IA storage class.
Archive: Archive storage class.
All: queries data of all storage classes.
When StorageType is set to All, you must set DirectoryOnly to true
parameters.help_zh:
分级存储类型。
InfrequentAccess：低频存储。
Archive：归档存储。
All：查询所有存储数据。
当StorageType取值为ALL时，必须配置DirectoryOnly参数，且值为true
parameters.name: storage_type

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to query only directories.

Valid values:

false (default): No. Both directories and files can be queried.
true: Yes. Only directories are queried.
When StorageType is set to All, DirectoryOnly must be set to true and cannot be set to false
parameters.help_zh:
是否只查询目录。

取值：

false（默认值）：否，可以查询目录或文件
true：是，只查询目录
当StorageType取值为All时，DirectoryOnly取值为true，不能为false
parameters.name: directory_only

parameters.help_en:
The number of directories or files included in each query result.

Valid values: 10 to 128.

Default value: 100
parameters.help_zh:
每次查询结果中包含的目录或文件的个数。

取值范围：10~128

默认值：100
parameters.name: max_results
